description:
[Wicked Reputation] Register your wallet as an agent (no stake required). Needs your signature over reputation_get_nonce's message; this tool never signs.

Use when you want to register your wallet as an agent, with your own signature over the nonce message. Not for staking (use reputation_stake after funding the treasury).

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

nonce.description: Nonce from a FRESH reputation_get_nonce call.

signature.description: 0x-prefixed ECDSA signature (EIP-191) over that nonce's message, from YOUR wallet.

name: reputation_register
